name: cte-select-quoted-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 "version") UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-explicit-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 AS "version") UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-bare-alias
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT version FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-all-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT ALL version FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-distinct-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT version FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-distinct-on-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) version FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-function-argument
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT abs(version) FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-operator-operand
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 0 OPERATOR(pg_catalog.+) version FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';

name: cte-select-sibling-column
sql: WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1 "version", version AS value FROM items) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed';
